name: c11_follow_me
purpose: Follow Me takes the foes' single-target moves: Kingambit's Sucker Punch aimed at Milotic goes to Indeedee-F, which already moved, so it fails; Basculegion's Flip Turn goes into Indeedee-F's Rocky Helmet and pivots while the volatile is live; Milotic's own move is not redirected; Charizard's Heat Wave hits both; Kingambit's Iron Head aimed at its own ally Charizard goes to Indeedee-F.
